remarks: Two story Traditional home features a large living room with lots of light, spacious formal dining room off of Eat In Kitchen area, first floor laundry, a full bath with a shower stall, an enclosed side porch area, perfect for a small office, and first floor bedroom. Upstairs you will find 3 bedrooms, including a large primary bedroom with ensuite bathroom with a porcelain tub. Large fenced-in side lot and a garden shed outside for storage.  The home is vacant and needs renovations.  All utilities will need to be inspected prior to turning them on. Buyer will be responsible for that. Seller makes no warranties as to the condition of the home, as they never owned or lived in the home. All offers will be made on PROPOFFERS.COM by a licensed Real Estate Agent and a transaction fee will be accessed at closing to the buyer's agent.  A showing release will need to be signed prior to any showings and returned to the listing agent for record. Please bring a flashlight.
